title: Permission Flags
hints: Each octal digit is 3 bits: read (4), write (2) and execute (1). 7 = 4 + 2 + 1 = rwx, 5 = 4 + 1 = r-x.
From a digit to letters: (d & 4) != 0 means r, (d & 2) != 0 means w, (d & 1) != 0 means x. From letters to a digit: add 4, 2 and 1 for the letters present.
Tell the two kinds of input apart by their length: 3 characters or 9. Check every character before printing.

pt-br.title: Flags de permissão
hints: Cada dígito octal são 3 bits: leitura (4), escrita (2) e execução (1). 7 = 4 + 2 + 1 = rwx, 5 = 4 + 1 = r-x.
De um dígito para letras: (d & 4) != 0 quer dizer r, (d & 2) != 0 quer dizer w, (d & 1) != 0 quer dizer x. De letras para um dígito: some 4, 2 e 1 para as letras presentes.
Diferencie os dois tipos de entrada pelo tamanho: 3 caracteres ou 9. Confira cada caractere antes de imprimir.
mustContain: Use os operadores bit a bit & ou | com as máscaras 4, 2 e 1.

mustContain.message: Use the bitwise operators & or | with the masks 4, 2 and 1.
